Policy: shop_id = caller setting (10)

Two different products share the text P7
Key	Product	Price	Query result
(10, P7)	Blue mug	20.00	Returned
(20, P7)	Copper mug	18.00	Hidden

runtime_10 receives Blue mug, 20.00. Change the caller setting to try the other shop.

What the comparison shows
